#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    vector<int> sequence;
    sequence.push_back(1);
    int current = 1;
    while (true) {
        int next_val = (current * k) % p;
        if (next_val == 1) break;
        sequence.push_back(next_val);
        current = next_val;
    }
    int cycle_length = sequence.size();
    int repetitions = (p - 1) / cycle_length;
    long long result = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < repetitions; ++i) {
        result = (result * p) % 1000000007;
    }
    cout << result;
    return 0;
}
